message.content:
This editorial illustration features a central human figure from the waist up. The figure wears a dark shirt under a grey vest with multiple pockets and a "KPK" patch on the left chest. Their face is covered by a light-blue surgical mask worn over the eyes like a blindfold. A large, bright red, vein-textured hand is positioned vertically over the center of the figure's face and torso, with fingers extending upward and the palm facing inward. The figure’s own grey-toned hands are raised at the sides in a grasping gesture.

The background is plain white with a red vertical bar on the left. Overlaid text at the top reads "WAWANCARA GEMBONG SARACEN" and "BUKA-BUKAAN KORUPSI PM MALAYSIA". Large, semi-transparent grey letters "TEMPO" appear behind the figure's head. Centered on the chest is the title "PENYUSUP DALAM SELIMUT" in bold black text. Below this, smaller white text begins with "KPK MEMERIKSA DIREKTUR..." and ends with "...SETYA NOVANTO." At the bottom, a barcode and "28 AGUSTUS-3 SEPTEMBER 2017" are visible. The entire composition uses a limited palette of grey, black, white, red, and pale blue.
